name: xTool S1 10W
tagline: Entry enclosed S1 : engraving-first with swappable head ecosystem
tldr: The 10W S1 is xTool's entry enclosed bundle: same Class-1 cabinet as 20W/40W, but the installed diode module limits cutting depth. You can upgrade later by swapping the laser head : verify you are buying the 10W SKU, not a bare machine without a module.

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: 10W on xTool S1: engraving-first : photo fills and leather at moderate speeds
Swappable head on the same chassis : upgrade power without replacing the whole machine
Integrated cabinet helps contain the beam and everyday smoke versus open-frame diodes
Software on the profile : trial your workflow on scrap before production

editorialDepth.advantages: The 10W diode module on xTool S1 is right when you mostly engrave wood, leather, and slate and should not pay for cut watts you will not use weekly. Same chassis, upgrade path later.
editorialDepth.limitations: Skip this module if you cut 5 mm+ stock daily : open the 20W or 40W profile. Cast acrylic and bare metal without spray stay frustrating on diode.

cons: Clear cast acrylic and thick production cutting still favor CO₂, not diode power alone
Confirm optical wattage on the listing before you buy
beginnerNotes: This profile is the 10W SKU on xTool S1. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks above, then compare other modules via the chips before buying.
proTips: Run material test grids at engraving speeds first. Add air assist for light cuts. If cut jobs exceed ~30% of your week, open the higher-watt profile on this site and compare times.

faq.question: Is the xTool S1 safer than an open-frame laser?
faq.answer: Yes. The enclosure blocks direct beam exposure and contains smoke. You still follow safety rules, but accidental exposure risk is much lower than open-frame diodes.

faq.question: Can the S1 replace a CO₂ laser?
faq.answer: No. It is still a diode laser with the same acrylic and cutting limits. Buy CO₂ (like xTool P2) if clear acrylic and thick wood cutting are your main work.

faq.question: Can I upgrade from 20W to 40W later?
faq.answer: Yes. S1 laser heads are interchangeable : buy a 40W module and swap it on the same enclosure (two screws + connectors). You can also add the optional 2W 1064 nm IR module for more metal work.

faq.question: Is the S1 a hybrid laser like the F1 Ultra?
faq.answer: No. S1 is a diode platform with swappable diode (or IR) heads. Hybrid machines combine fiber and diode sources inside one dual-source product : different category.

mainObjective: High-quality hobby and light-business engraving with light, slow cutting

moduleSystem.headline: Interchangeable laser heads on the same S1 cabinet
moduleSystem.description: The xTool S1 is sold with different diode modules (10W, 20W, or 40W) or as a bare cabinet : heads swap with two screws and a plug. An optional 2W 1064 nm infrared module adds metal marking without a full fiber galvo. This is not a “hybrid” machine: you replace one head at a time.
